paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the BLEU scores of two models, Consistency-CE (represented by a blue dashed line with circle markers) and Consistency-Bi (represented by an orange solid line with square markers), as a function of the length of the gold prefix, ranging from 0 to 20. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix” and uses a linear scale, while the y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and also uses a linear scale, spanning from 23 to 29. The Consistency-CE model begins at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5, dips to a minimum of about 23.8 at a prefix length of 2, and then steadily increases to reach approximately 27.8 at a prefix length of 20. The Consistency-Bi model starts at a BLEU score of about 27.6, remains relatively stable at that level until a prefix length of around 5, then gradually declines to a final score of approximately 23.9 at a prefix length of 20. The two lines intersect at a prefix length of approximately 12, where both models achieve a BLEU score of about 26.
